dos.text: Always set both value and label, the parent moz-segmented-control needs value for identity and label for display, neither is optional in real usage.
Listen for the real input/change events for selection handling, the item isn't backed by a native input and manually dispatches both on click.

donts.text: Don't use this component outside a real moz-segmented-control parent, size and parentDisabled are explicitly set by that parent, there's no standalone usage documented.
Don't expect accessKey to show a visible hint on its own, it wires a real keyboard shortcut but any visible indicator is the parent's concern, not this item's.
